title: Crews Slurry Seal San Diego Roads
description:
More San Diego communities will soon enjoy smoother roads as slurry seal continues in January. This proactive maintenance helps extend the life of our streets and saves on costly repairs down the road.

For more information on the project and roads that will be resurfaced, visit: insidesandiego.org/road-repair-projects-continue-pacific-beach-la-jolla-carmel-valley-pacific-highlands-ranch-and
